objective: Test-independent statistical audit of the preregistered Step9-v7 augmentation controls and Step15-v7 reliability veto. Representative validation governs selection; the legacy 200-row Chinese test is diagnostic only and cannot support publication promotion.

paired_comparisons.primary_interpretation: Does English-label-only clean fusion improve on the frozen multilingual semantic encoder before target-domain supervision is added?
Does target-domain support improve the matched clean fusion model over English-label-only transfer?
Does interpolation improve ranking beyond merely adding identical positive effective weight?
Does the complete latent-mixup treatment improve the unaugmented clean ranker?
How much benefit comes from positive effective weight alone?
Does the validation-selected clean fusion improve on the same identifier-redacted E5 cosine used to construct its latent representation?
Does inference-visible identifier reliability reduce public-contact noise without degrading clean ranking?

publication_promotion.reason: No publication promotion is permitted on the legacy internal-development test. A one-time prospective Step20 holdout is mandatory.

hard_rules: All model and threshold selection uses representative validation only.
Internal-development test metrics are diagnostic and never alter model selection.
Mixup and duplication must have identical synthetic effective weight for every seed.
The model-freeze manifest is written before any prospective holdout label is unsealed.
No v7 result is publication-promoted until Step20 one-time evaluation succeeds.
